founderPriorityOverride.source: Autobuilder backlog order 16 after region_bet_monitor_value_v1; orders 14 and 15 remain archive-gated and deferred.
founderPriorityOverride.purpose: Add a paper-only management journal without blocking on unrelated historical replay work.

productScope.summary: Record educational Region Bet state and paper management decisions in Monitor.

acceptanceCriteria: Classify a saved Region Bet as alive, improving, deteriorating, invalidated, or expired from explicit user input and observable state.
Record hold, paper-exit, paper-roll, paper-adjust, and note actions as journal entries without placing or simulating broker orders.
Require a timestamp and optional rationale for every state or management update and retain prior entries immutably.
Keep all copy educational and descriptive; do not recommend an action or imply live execution.
Cover valid transitions, invalid transitions, journal ordering, owner isolation, and Monitor rendering with focused tests.
